card.line: The Brook of Egypt was a stream that marked the far southwestern edge of the land God gave Israel, near the Great Sea.

moments.title: Southern border of Judah
moments.text: Judah's southern border ran to Azmon, joined the Brook of Egypt, and ended at the Sea.

moments.title: Southern edge of the land
moments.text: In Ezekiel's vision of the land, the southern border ran from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh, and along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea.
